dz: 《卢布洛瓦条约》：在《索恩和约》签订后，大团长海因里希·冯·普劳恩向匈牙利的西吉斯蒙德请求经济援助。西吉斯蒙德同意调解削减第三期付款、划定萨莫吉希亚边界等事宜，并举办盛大的比武大会，以及狩猎和奢华宴会。他邀请了波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃、海因里希·冯·普劳恩和波斯尼亚国王特夫尔特科二世等人。与会者来自17个国家、使用不同语言，其中有40.000名贵族和2000……（原文在此截断）
de: Treaty of Lublowa: After the Peace of Thorn, Grand Master Heinrich von Plauen asks Sigismund of Hungary for economic aid. Sigismund agrees to mediate reduction to the third installment, demarcation of the Samogitian border, and other matters with a grand tournament. Hunts and lavish feasts were also organized. Sigismund invited, among others, polish king Wladyslaw Jagiello, Heinrich von Plauen and bosnian king Tvrtko II. There were people from 17 countries and languages - 40.000 nobles and 2000…

dz: 匈牙利王国和波兰王国之间的"卢博瓦拉条约"得到确认,这是在布达举行的规模最大和宏伟的皇家会议和宴会之一. 匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德(Sigismund)接待了国王瓦瓦季斯劳 二世·贾吉约(Wladyswalw II Jagiełło),同时有数千名贵族出席.
de: The Treaty of Lubowla between the kingdoms of Hungary and Poland is confirmed with one of the largest and magnificent royal meetings and feasts ever held in Buda. King Sigismund of Hungary host king Władysław II Jagiełło while several thousand nobles attend.
